title: Convenience store (colmado) selling beer to go and cigarettes, existing leased storefront, no construction — Vieques, coastal zone X
description: We are opening a small convenience store (colmado) in an existing leased storefront in Isabel Segunda, Vieques. We will sell packaged groceries, snacks, sodas, beer to go and cigarettes. No construction; we move in as-is. Two employees.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020, Arts. 7.200-7.207).
RULE_0007: physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Art. 8.4A, Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0012: packaged food sold (Q_FOOD_SOLD) -> sanitary permit for a food establishment (Ley 81-1912, 3 LPRA 178).
RULE_0013: beer sold to go (Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD) -> Hacienda internal-revenue alcohol license (Sec. 5022.01, Ley 1-2011).
RULE_0621 (alcohol) and RULE_0703 (tobacco): CRIM debt certification is a Hacienda license prerequisite.
RULE_0624 (alcohol) and RULE_0702 (tobacco): ASUME certification is a Hacienda license prerequisite.
RULE_0627 (alcohol) and RULE_0704 (tobacco): Certificado de Antecedentes Penales is a Hacienda license prerequisite.
RULE_0701: cigarettes sold (Q_TOBACCO_SOLD) -> retail cigarette dealer license (Sec. 3050.01, Ley 1-2011).
RULE_0705: the tobacco retail license file includes the projected sales volume (Hacienda requisitos, Licencia de Detallista de Cigarrillos).
RULE_0020: employees -> CFSE workers' compensation policy.

RULE_0517 (municipality flag island + BT_CONVENIENCE_STORE): Vieques/Culebra cargo logistics with the ATI ferry operator. The document is uncited (procedural, citation_confidence not_applicable), so it may only appear as conditional.
RULE_0648: confirmed leased tenure -> the lease is supporting evidence for the permit file.

mustNotInclude.rationale: The ATM/ATI ferry manifest has no statutory citation in the KB; an uncited procedural document must never render as REQUIRED.
No construction stated ('we move in as-is'): RULE_0643-0646 need a construction / renovation project type or structural work.
RULE_0708 needs location.czm AND a development fact (construction, renovation, expansion, exterior or site work); moving into an existing storefront as-is has none.
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.

Vieques carries the tourism flag, but RULE_0033, RULE_0139-0148 and RULE_0261-0264 attach the Turismo innkeeper registration only to lodging (hotel, resort, guest house, short-term rental business types or Q_SHORT_TERM_RENTAL).
Commercial-tourist (C-T) district on urban land, no change of use: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-16 by the scenario loop: first convenience store, first tobacco-retail and first Vieques scenario (island municipality flag). Not asserted, for expert review: (1) RULE_0517-type ferry-manifest cards (RULE_0508-0517) carry no statutory citation; whether they belong on the checklist at all, or only as logistics guidance, is a product/legal call. (2) DOC_ALCOHOL_SALES_PROJECTION renders needs_more_information (RULE_0665 heuristic) while the parallel DOC_TOBACCO_SALES_PROJECTION renders required; the Hacienda requirements page lists a sales projection for both licenses, so the asymmetry is worth an expert look. (3) Whether a retailer selling only sealed beer for off-premises consumption needs any municipal alcohol-hours or zoning endorsement in Vieques is not modeled.
